provenance: Public fork based on the pinned upstream commit. Original source directories remain in Git; the private local package exports only the reviewed authenticated host wrapper.

localPatchBoundaries.host: index.js and server.js provide authenticated fixed /m assets only; no original lib/client entry is loaded
localPatchBoundaries.theme: theme.js extracts the pinned inline bootstrap; server index transform replaces only that known block and sets Japanese language/title
localPatchBoundaries.browser: web/app.js, style.css, index.html and manifest.webmanifest may carry reviewed Japanese and security patches
localPatchBoundaries.storage: No service worker, offline cache, session transcript storage, launch-token persistence, or new host trust grant is introduced
localPatchBoundaries.tests: Dependency-free route and extracted browser-handler tests run locally. An optional installed-runtime fence test imports only the package explicitly selected by DSH_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_ROOT.
